DE 10 BESTE restaurants in Chiang Khan (2026) - Tripadvisor
Chiang Khan Travel Guide 2026: Top Attractions, Things to Do & ...

Chiang Khan is a small northern Isaan town situated on the banks of the Mekong River, with Laos on the other side. Its main attraction are the evening markets, which are held on the road that borders the river, and is lined with renovated timber houses. This becomes a walking street in the late afternoon, with no motor vehicles. I like these markets better than any other I have seen in Thailand. The setting with the timber structures is unique, the shops are far better presented than is usual, there are lots of food and drinking options, and on a weekend, or New Day's Day, which is when we visited, it is bustling with tourist Thais. I spotted two westerners - my sort of place. I normally visit purely for the markets, so I can't comment on what else is on offer in the town. Apart from the walking street, which looks great lit up at night, the rest is standard Thai concrete ugly, but driving in there were some riverside places that I would have liked to explore if I had more time. Unless things have changed, almost nothing is open in the daytime on walking street, and the place seems semi-deserted. Don't expect a lively place outside the market time.
